characters.name: ORAV OTT
characters.description: Väike oranžikas orav koheva sabaga, seljas roheline kampsun, suured uudishimulikud silmad ja rõõmsameelne naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: SIIL SASSI
characters.description: Väike pruun siil pehmete okastega, kaelas kollane sall, armas nööpnina ja sõbralik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Sügisene aed
locations.description: Sunny autumn garden with green grass, red and yellow leafed trees, simple wooden fence in the background, warm sunlight, clean bright atmosphere. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Orav Ott in a green sweater and Siil Sassi in a yellow scarf stand together in the autumn garden on green grass under bright trees. Warm sunny autumn day. Cartoon style.
Colorful red, yellow, and orange leaves are falling softly from trees around Orav Ott and Siil Sassi. Both look up at the falling leaves happily. Same autumn garden.
Orav Ott holds a small wooden rake and Siil Sassi holds a small basket, picking up colorful autumn leaves from the grass. Garden background.
Orav Ott uses his wooden rake to push bright red and yellow leaves into a neat pile on the green lawn. Siil Sassi watches happily.
Siil Sassi carries a basket full of colorful leaves and pours them onto the growing leaf pile. Orav Ott smiles next to the pile.
A giant, fluffy pile of bright autumn leaves stands on the lawn. Orav Ott and Siil Sassi stand beside the huge pile, bouncing excitedly.
Orav Ott and Siil Sassi jump joyfully through the air straight into the center of the giant leaf pile, splashing leaves around.
Orav Ott and Siil Sassi sit popping out from inside the huge soft leaf pile with leaves on their heads, laughing with delight.

Orav Ott (green sweater only, bare orange legs and paws, no trousers or shoes) and Siil Sassi sit together on the grass next to the scattered leaf pile, hugging and smiling warmly at each other in the warm autumn sunlight.
